en.heading: Wiring on {board}
en.led: {label}: {color} LED with a {ohms} resistor in series, from {pin} to GND ({ground}).
en.button: {label}: push button between {pin} and GND ({ground}); the internal pull-up of the board reads it.
en.jumper: {label}: jumper wire from {pin} to GND ({ground}); plugged in means on.
en.potentiometer: {label}: {ohms} potentiometer, ends to 3V3 ({supply}) and GND ({analogGround}), wiper to {pin}.
en.onBoard: {label}: {pinName} ({location}, {id}) is on the board; it needs no wiring.

es.heading: Cableado en {board}
es.led: {label}: LED {color} con una resistencia de {ohms} en serie, desde {pin} hasta GND ({ground}).
es.button: {label}: pulsador entre {pin} y GND ({ground}); la placa lo lee con su resistencia de pull-up interna.
es.jumper: {label}: cable puente desde {pin} hasta GND ({ground}); conectado significa activado.
es.potentiometer: {label}: potenciómetro de {ohms}, extremos a 3V3 ({supply}) y GND ({analogGround}), cursor a {pin}.
es.onBoard: {label}: {pinName} ({location}, {id}) está en la placa; no necesita cableado.
